findings.summary: A cleanup command of mine killed more processes than intended
findings.detail: To stop a hung smoke script I ran Stop-Process on every process whose command line contained 'browser-smoke.mts' or whose executable path contained 'ms-playwright'. It ended 19 processes: bash/sh/cmd/node (mine) plus chrome-headless-shell and firefox (most likely the browsers my script leaked, since the script did not close a browser when page.goto failed). I cannot rule out that one of those browser or shell processes belonged to another unit running at the same time (about 20:00-20:05 local on 2026-10-25). If another unit of this run reported an unexplained hang, kill or lost shell in that window, run its check again. No project file was affected. The script was fixed to close browsers in a finally block and no broad kill was used afterwards.

findings.summary: RULE-ra-11 says the file carries only the company name; the file also carries the company's opaque record id
findings.detail: Import has to tell 'file of another company' from 'file of this company' (AC-ra-52) and names are not unique or stable, so company.id travels in the file and comes back in the .fitpulse file. It is the company's own id, nothing of any other company (the unit test asserts both generated files contain nothing of the other). If the API unit prefers matching by name only it can ignore company.id.

findings.summary: The client's money mask is a ported copy of shared/format/money.ts maskMoneyInput, not an import
findings.detail: rules/form-fields-masks-and-validation.md says reuse the project's mask utilities. The questionnaire has to be one self-contained HTML with no module loading, so the mask is ported into questionnaireClient.js. tests/unit/questionnaireFile.test.ts loads the real client script and compares it with maskMoneyInput over 3,200 random keystrokes (digits, backspace, delete, non-digits, caret position, the 13-digit limit) plus fixed cases, so a change to the shared mask fails the test until the client is updated.

messages.text: IF-004 contract of the .fitpulse answers file, produced by questionnaireClient.js and described by exports of server/questionnaire/questionnaireFile.ts (importing the module has no side effects; the .js and .css are read on the first buildQuestionnaireFile call). The file is JSON: { format: ANSWERS_FILE_FORMAT ('fitpulse-answers'), formatVersion: ANSWERS_FILE_FORMAT_VERSION (1), questionnaireVersion: QUESTIONNAIRE_VERSION (1), company: { id, name }, savedAt: ISO-8601 string from the client's clock, answers, calculator }. Refuse with the RULE-ra-10 messages: format different -> corrupted ('Este arquivo nao e um arquivo de respostas do FitPulse.'); formatVersion > app's -> newer; questionnaireVersion different, or answers keys the catalog does not know -> incompatible; company.id different from the company in the URL -> other company (name in the message comes from company.name). answers and calculator are exactly the shape of diagnosisPatchSchema (answers/calculator keys): a question key is present only if it was answered, null only where the catalog offers 'nao sei'; calculator keys are present only if filled and only for the mode picked (spendParts only with spendMode 'exact', spendRange only with 'range'; same for newCustomers); an unanswered file can legitimately carry answers {} and calculator {}. The unit test checks that the client output passes diagnosisPatchSchema.safeParse. Generation API: buildQuestionnaireFile({ company: { id, name }, brand: { name, phone, email, logoDataUrl } | null, sentAt: Date }) returns { html, fileName ('{empresa}-questionario-AAAA-MM-DD.html', local date), answersFileName ('respostas-{empresa}.fitpulse') }. brand.phone must already be the display text (for example '(11) 91234-5678'); logoDataUrl must be data:image/png|jpeg|webp;base64 (anything else is dropped); a brand whose fields are all empty is treated as no brand. buildClientMessage(companyName, brandName | null) returns the approved message for 'Copiar mensagem'. slugifyForFileName, questionnaireFileName and answersFileName are exported too. Constants for the 1 MB limit are not defined here.

The dialog cannot import server code. The approved 'mensagem ao cliente' is built by buildClientMessage(companyName, brandName) in server/questionnaire/questionnaireFile.ts; the questionnaireService should return it (for example as a message field of POST /api/companies/:id/questionnaire) so SendQuestionnaireDialog shows exactly that text. The file's own texts (desktop notice, 'Revise e salve', 'N de 8 blocos respondidos', 'Salvar minhas respostas', 'Respostas salvas' and the send instruction with the brand) are inside the generated file and need no UI work.

Owner step still open (Q-10). Before handing the example to the owner, run 'pnpm exec vitest run tests/unit/questionnaireFile.test.ts' again: Playwright empties test-results/ at the start of every run, so test-results/questionario-exemplo.html may be gone. The owner sends it by Gmail, Outlook and WhatsApp to another computer, opens it in Chrome, Edge, Firefox and Safari, answers, saves, and notes any antivirus or e-mail block. Then record the matrix with aioson dossier:add-finding . --slug=relatorios-e-acompanhamento --agent=dev --section="Q-10". If a required channel or browser fails, stop Phase 6 and return to @product (forms A or C); the later Phase 6 units (API, attention, frontend) should not be treated as approved before that.

For tests/e2e/remoteQuestionnaire.spec.ts: the generated file works in a real Chromium with zero requests (page.on('request') saw only the file: document), zero CSP violations and no page errors, and axe-core finds nothing in dark or light on block 1, a question block, the review screen and the saved screen. My ad hoc smoke (not in the repo; the run-scoped temp dir is removed on success) covered: help buttons, money mask and total, new-customers limit error, mode switch keeping typed values, partial save with one block missing (19 answers, 'Revise e salve' showing '7 de 8 blocos respondidos.' and one link), 'Baixar de novo', the missing-block link, the complete save (24 answers + 6 numbers, file name respostas-academia-forca-total.fitpulse, passes diagnosisPatchSchema), and the narrow-screen notice. It found and fixed one real bug (aria-labelledby of the mode areas was '[object HTMLDivElement]'), so keep an axe check and the mode switch ('Sei mais ou menos' then back to 'Sei os valores') in the e2e. Selectors available in the page: h1 'Questionario de crescimento', role=note notice, nav 'Blocos do questionario' (8 links), radio inputs named answer-{questionId} (values 0-3 or 'unknown'), mode-spend and mode-newCustomers radios (exact, range, unknown), #spend-ads... #spend-tools, #new-customers, #average-purchase, #margin, buttons 'Proximo bloco', 'Revisar', 'Salvar minhas respostas', 'Baixar de novo', 'Voltar as respostas'.

Packaging: questionnaireFile.ts reads questionnaireClient.js and questionnaireStyles.css next to itself with fs at run time (import.meta.url). They must be in the shipped package (the plan ships server/ in source mode); node scripts/smoke-store-package.mjs is the place to confirm it. shared/content/questionBank.ts was left unchanged, as the plan says (reuse).
